Definition: Post-observation shift: 1 if the most recent tool result was untrusted and had x^ctx^_2 = 1; otherwise 0
Repeated calls: min(n_rep, n_max) / n_max, where n_rep is the number of consecutive calls with the same tool and key arguments and n_max is declared
Privilege escalation: 1 if the privilege level of a_t's tool exceeds the highest level used so far in the episode; otherwise 0
Transition deviation: 1 if the pair (previous tool, current tool) does not occur in the benign reference transition set; otherwise 0
Availability: Derived; reference set estimated on benign fitting data

Definition: Argument provenance: 1 if a key argument of a_t (recipient account identifier, amount, password, or profile value) occurs in untrusted content but not in g or trusted content; otherwise 0
Destination novelty: 1 if the recipient of a_t appears neither in g nor among the transactions observed before the episode's first untrusted ingestion; otherwise 0
Availability: Derived; applicable to value-transfer and payment-modification tools

Definition: Sensitive egress: 1 if a_t sends to an external recipient a value obtained from a sensitive read (account identifier, profile value, or credential); otherwise 0
Availability: Derived from L1 entities and H_t
